gitCommit.subject: docs: SDUI §138 — the compliance change, accounted as a boundary no-op
gitCommit.body:
docs: SDUI §138 — the compliance change, accounted as a boundary no-op

Zero iOS: risk-rating is server-internal (webhook, reconcile cron,
post-payment), everything else is admin-only, and the CHECK widening
changes no existing row.

Carries the two points that are not obvious from the diff: why the status
had to be `cleared` rather than `reviewed` (the review cron's exclusion
list), and why the Control Tower mirror needed changing too — the same
case appears in a second place, and fixing only one is the half-fix shape
this repo keeps hitting.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
